text:
Marta L: Quick heads-up 8: I created a PR to tighten our retention language and add a short export example for audit logs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428

Devin K: Can you paste the new copy here so legal can scan?

Marta L: Draft paragraph in PR:

```
Default audit-log retention: 90 days. Audit logs and operational telemetry are retained to support security investigations and compliance. Customer content is redacted by default and is not used for model training, except where an explicit opt-in is provided by the customer and covered by a written agreement. Customers on enterprise contracts may request extended retention.
```

Marta L: I also added two small examples: a JS SDK snippet for initiating an export and a curl example for the Console API.

Ryan S: Small nit: replace "retained to support" with "retained for" and add a reference link to the retention policy page.

Samira (Legal): From legal: please avoid the phrase "redacted by default" without clarifying what fields. Suggest: "We redact PII and sensitive identifiers by default; customers can supply additional redaction rules via the Console." Also, as you have, keep the explicit opt-in exception for training.

Devin K: Updated the JS snippet in the PR to the current client API:

```js
// JS: request audit log export
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const exportResp = await client.auditLogs.exports.create({
  range: { from: '2025-06-01', to: '2025-06-30' },
  format: 'ndjson'
});
console.log(exportResp.download_url);
```

Devin K: And a curl version for docs readers who use the Console API:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit-logs/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from":"2025-06-01","to":"2025-06-30","format":"ndjson"}'
```

Marta L: Nice. Ill add the retention-policy link inline: /security/data-retention and a short callout: "Redaction: PII and identifiers are removed by default; custom rules supported via Console."

Samira (Legal): Approved wording with those clarifications. Minor request: change "customer content" to "customer content and customer-provided data" in one spot to be explicit.

Ryan S: Will run a quick cross-check with our last SOC2 artifact set; this wording should be fine. :thumbsup:

docs-bot: CI: docs/lint passed for PR #428 (4 files changed) :white_check_mark:

Marta L: Thanks everyone. I'll push the wording tweak and the two snippets, then merge after 24h if no objections. I'll also add a bullet in the changelog for the docs release.

Devin K: I'll watch the PR and confirm the JS snippet is in the right snippet include.

Samira (Legal): Approved from legal after final commit.

Marta L: Merging after CI green.
